description: Ministry of Provincial Councils & Local Government - Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with electoral processes and local government administration. It dissolves and constitutes Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies), defines their electoral boundaries, specifies member composition (elected and returned members), and sets commencement dates for their terms of office. While it mentions Minister Faiszer Musthapha, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily an elections-related matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
